Root cause: SyncRecording*Repository.seed() discarded the inner async Promise (void { this.inner.seed(items) }) so callers doing `await repos.households.seed(...)` etc in ensureDemoFixture resolved immediately while SQLite INSERTs were still in flight; the fixture then performed membership-checked reads (tasks.getByHousehold → checkMembership → memberships.getByHousehold) which returned [] if the memberships INSERT had not committed, causing CROSS_TENANT rejection and on-device symptom "signed in but Aucun groupe forever" — golden path never reaches Ajouter/Balances/À faire and finalizer times out. Fix makes every wrapper seed() async and `await this.inner.seed(items)` so demo fixture ordering is deterministic; InMemory sync repos remain compatible (await undefined resolves immediately).
